title.es: Seguro Medico para Parejas LGBTQ en 2026 | CoveredUSA

description.en: LGBTQ couples health insurance 2026: same-sex marriage vs domestic partner coverage, joint PTC filing, HSA rules, and Marketplace SEP triggers.
description.es: Seguro medico para parejas LGBTQ en 2026: matrimonio del mismo sexo vs pareja domestica, declaracion conjunta del PTC, reglas del HSA y SEP del Mercado.

h1.en: Health Insurance for LGBTQ Couples in 2026
h1.es: Seguro Medico para Parejas LGBTQ en 2026

subhero.en: Same-sex married couples and unmarried domestic partners face different rules on the ACA Marketplace in 2026. Married couples must file jointly to claim the Premium Tax Credit, while most domestic partners apply as separate households, and getting that math wrong before open enrollment or a wedding date can cost thousands.
subhero.es: Las parejas del mismo sexo casadas y las parejas domesticas no casadas enfrentan reglas distintas en el Mercado del ACA en 2026. Las parejas casadas deben declarar impuestos conjuntamente para reclamar el Credito Fiscal de Prima, mientras que la mayoria de las parejas domesticas solicitan como hogares separados.

quickAnswer.en: LGBTQ couples in 2026 typically choose between an ACA Marketplace plan, an employer plan through one partner's job, an HSA-qualified family HDHP, or COBRA after a divorce or job change. A same-sex married couple must file Married Filing Jointly to claim the Premium Tax Credit, and combined household MAGI determines eligibility up to the 400% FPL subsidy cliff that returned January 1, 2026. An unmarried domestic partner usually applies as a separate marketplace household with their own MAGI, unless the couple shares a dependent child. One quirk favors domestic partners on HSAs: if both partners are covered by the same family HDHP and neither is the other's tax dependent, each can contribute up to the full $8,750 family HSA limit in 2026 to a separate account, while married couples must split one shared family limit.
quickAnswer.es: Las parejas LGBTQ en 2026 generalmente eligen entre un plan del Mercado ACA, un plan del empleador a traves del trabajo de un socio, un HDHP familiar compatible con HSA, o COBRA despues de un divorcio o cambio de trabajo. Una pareja del mismo sexo casada debe declarar como Casado Presentando Conjuntamente para reclamar el Credito Fiscal de Prima, y el MAGI combinado del hogar determina la elegibilidad hasta el tope del subsidio del 400% FPL que regreso el 1 de enero de 2026. Una pareja domestica no casada generalmente solicita como un hogar separado con su propio MAGI, a menos que la pareja comparta un hijo dependiente. Una particularidad favorece a las parejas domesticas en los HSA: si ambos socios estan cubiertos por el mismo HDHP familiar y ninguno es dependiente fiscal del otro, cada uno puede aportar hasta el limite familiar completo de $8,750 del HSA en 2026 a una cuenta separada, mientras que las parejas casadas deben dividir un solo limite familiar compartido.

introParagraphs.en: Married and unmarried LGBTQ couples make health insurance decisions that single LGBTQ individuals do not face: whose employer plan to join, whether registering as domestic partners changes a paycheck's taxable wages, and how joint tax filing reshapes Premium Tax Credit eligibility. A same-sex married couple applying for a 2026 Marketplace plan uses combined household income and must file jointly, exactly like an opposite-sex married couple. A same-sex couple that is not married, including many long-term partners and registered domestic partners, generally files as two separate tax households, which changes the subsidy math in ways that surprise plenty of first-time enrollees.
introParagraphs.es: Las parejas LGBTQ casadas y no casadas toman decisiones de seguro medico que las personas LGBTQ solteras no enfrentan: a que plan del empleador unirse, si registrarse como pareja domestica cambia el salario sujeto a impuestos, y como la declaracion conjunta reconfigura la elegibilidad del Credito Fiscal de Prima. Una pareja del mismo sexo casada que solicita un plan del Mercado 2026 usa el ingreso combinado del hogar y debe declarar conjuntamente, igual que una pareja de sexo opuesto casada. Una pareja del mismo sexo que no esta casada, incluyendo muchas parejas de largo plazo y parejas domesticas registradas, generalmente declara como dos hogares fiscales separados, lo que cambia las matematicas del subsidio de formas que sorprenden a muchos inscritos por primera vez.

introParagraphs.en: Gay couples, lesbian couples, and other same-sex domestic partnerships working through joint versus separate coverage decisions are the focus of this guide, including a partner nearing 26 who is aging off a parent's plan or a couple raising a child through second-parent adoption. Single LGBTQ readers looking for gender-affirming care coverage details or individual subsidy rules should see the [LGBTQ individuals guide](/en/for/lgbtq) instead. The [MAGI glossary entry](/en/glossary/magi) explains how income is calculated for subsidy purposes, and [ACA income limits for 2026](/en/aca-income-limits) lists exact thresholds by household size.
introParagraphs.es: Parejas gay, parejas lesbianas y otras parejas domesticas del mismo sexo que estan decidiendo entre cobertura conjunta o separada son el enfoque de esta guia, incluyendo un socio que se acerca a los 26 anos y sale del plan de sus padres, o una pareja que cria a un hijo mediante adopcion del segundo padre. Los lectores LGBTQ+ solteros que buscan detalles sobre atencion afirmante de genero o reglas individuales de subsidio deben ver la guia de personas LGBTQ+ en su lugar.

MAGI combinado o individual bajo 400% FPL

Un socio con buenos beneficios del empleador

footnote.en: The 400% FPL subsidy cliff returned January 1, 2026 after the Enhanced Premium Tax Credits from the Inflation Reduction Act of 2022 expired. Above 400% FPL, an LGBTQ couple pays full sticker price on the Marketplace regardless of marital status.
footnote.es: El tope del subsidio del 400% FPL regreso el 1 de enero de 2026 despues de que expiraron los Creditos Fiscales de Prima Mejorados de la Ley de Reduccion de Inflacion de 2022. Por encima del 400% FPL, una pareja LGBTQ paga el precio completo en el Mercado sin importar el estado civil.

heading.en: Option 1: ACA Marketplace Plan for Married Couples and Domestic Partners
heading.es: Opcion 1: Plan del Mercado ACA para parejas casadas y domesticas

paragraphs.en: A same-sex married couple applying for a 2026 Marketplace plan must file a joint federal tax return to claim the Premium Tax Credit. Combined household MAGI is measured against 400% FPL, which for a household of two in 2026 is $86,560. Subsidies phase down as combined income climbs toward that number and stop entirely at 400% FPL. Section 1095-A, the annual marketplace statement, reconciles the advance credits both spouses received against their actual joint income when they file.
paragraphs.es: Una pareja del mismo sexo casada que solicita un plan del Mercado 2026 debe presentar una declaracion federal conjunta para reclamar el Credito Fiscal de Prima. El MAGI combinado del hogar se mide contra el 400% FPL, que para un hogar de dos en 2026 es $86,560. Los subsidios disminuyen a medida que el ingreso combinado se acerca a ese numero y se detienen por completo en el 400% FPL.

paragraphs.en: An unmarried same-sex couple, including a registered domestic partner, generally files as two separate marketplace households. Each partner reports only their own income and calculates their own subsidy against the individual FPL thresholds, which can actually produce a larger combined subsidy than a married household in some income combinations. The exception: if the couple shares a dependent child claimed on one partner's tax return, that child's coverage and the claiming partner's household size both shift, so run the numbers both ways before enrolling.
paragraphs.es: Una pareja del mismo sexo no casada, incluyendo una pareja domestica registrada, generalmente solicita como dos hogares separados del mercado. Cada socio reporta solo su propio ingreso y calcula su propio subsidio contra los umbrales individuales del FPL, lo que puede producir un subsidio combinado mayor que un hogar casado en algunas combinaciones de ingresos. La excepcion: si la pareja comparte un hijo dependiente reclamado en la declaracion de un socio, el tamano del hogar de ese socio cambia.

heading.en: Option 2: Employer Plan via a Same-Sex Spouse or Domestic Partner
heading.es: Opcion 2: Plan del empleador via conyuge del mismo sexo o pareja domestica

paragraphs.en: A legally married same-sex spouse can be added to an employer plan during open enrollment or within a 60-day Marketplace SEP after the wedding date. Employer-paid premiums for a legal spouse are excluded from federal taxable income, identical to the treatment of an opposite-sex spouse. This is usually the cheapest path when one partner in a same-sex marriage has strong workplace benefits.
paragraphs.es: Un conyuge del mismo sexo legalmente casado puede agregarse a un plan del empleador durante la inscripcion abierta o dentro de un SEP de 60 dias despues de la fecha de la boda. Las primas pagadas por el empleador para un conyuge legal se excluyen del ingreso federal sujeto a impuestos, igual que para un conyuge de sexo opuesto.

paragraphs.en: An unmarried domestic partner added to an employer plan faces a different tax picture. Unless the domestic partner qualifies as a tax dependent under IRC Section 152 (living together and receiving more than half their support from the employee), the fair market value of the employer-paid coverage becomes imputed income on the employee's W-2, taxed as wages. At $400 to $600 a month in employer-paid domestic partner coverage, that adds $4,800 to $7,200 a year in taxable income, often $1,000 to $1,700 in extra federal tax.
paragraphs.es: Una pareja domestica no casada agregada a un plan del empleador enfrenta un panorama fiscal distinto. A menos que la pareja domestica califique como dependiente fiscal bajo la Seccion 152 del IRC, el valor de mercado de la cobertura pagada por el empleador se convierte en ingreso imputado en el W-2 del empleado. Con $400 a $600 al mes de cobertura pagada por el empleador, eso agrega $4,800 a $7,200 al ano en ingreso sujeto a impuestos.

heading.es: Opcion 3: HDHP familiar compatible con HSA

paragraphs.en: For LGBTQ couples above the 400% FPL subsidy cliff, an HSA-qualified family High-Deductible Health Plan (HDHP) usually beats a richer Marketplace plan on after-tax cost. The 2026 HDHP minimum deductible is $1,700 self-only or $3,400 family, and the maximum out-of-pocket is $8,500 self-only or $17,000 family. Both partners can be covered under a single family HDHP whether they are married, in a civil union, or unmarried domestic partners.
paragraphs.es: Para las parejas LGBTQ por encima del tope del subsidio del 400% FPL, un HDHP familiar compatible con HSA generalmente supera a un plan del Mercado mas rico en costo despues de impuestos. El deducible minimo del HDHP en 2026 es $1,700 individual o $3,400 familiar, y el maximo de bolsillo es $8,500 individual o $17,000 familiar.

paragraphs.en: A couple-specific quirk worth planning around: a married same-sex couple shares one combined $8,750 family HSA contribution limit for 2026, split however they agree. Unmarried domestic partners covered under the same family HDHP, if neither is claimed as the other's tax dependent, can each open a separate HSA and contribute up to the full $8,750 family limit individually, roughly doubling the household's tax-advantaged savings compared to a married couple with the same coverage.
paragraphs.es: Una particularidad especifica de parejas vale la pena planearla: una pareja del mismo sexo casada comparte un limite combinado de $8,750 para el HSA familiar en 2026, dividido como acuerden. Las parejas domesticas no casadas cubiertas bajo el mismo HDHP familiar, si ninguna es reclamada como dependiente fiscal de la otra, pueden abrir cada una una HSA separada y aportar hasta el limite familiar completo de $8,750 individualmente.

heading.en: Option 4: COBRA After Divorce, a Spouse's Death, or Job Loss
heading.es: Opcion 4: COBRA tras divorcio, muerte del conyuge o perdida de empleo

paragraphs.en: A same-sex spouse who loses coverage through divorce or a spouse's death can elect COBRA for up to 36 months, paying the full premium plus a 2% administrative fee. Losing coverage through a partner's job loss instead of divorce or death limits COBRA to 18 months. Because both divorce and job loss trigger a 60-day Marketplace SEP, most couples compare COBRA's higher cost against a subsidized Marketplace plan before deciding, and COBRA usually only wins when a specialist provider is out of network on every available Marketplace plan.
paragraphs.es: Un conyuge del mismo sexo que pierde cobertura por divorcio o muerte del conyuge puede elegir COBRA hasta por 36 meses, pagando la prima completa mas un cargo administrativo del 2%. Perder cobertura por la perdida de empleo de un socio en lugar de divorcio o muerte limita COBRA a 18 meses. Como el divorcio y la perdida de empleo activan un SEP de 60 dias en el Mercado, la mayoria de las parejas comparan el costo mas alto de COBRA contra un plan subsidiado del Mercado antes de decidir.

intro.en: LGBTQ couples, whether a gay couple, a lesbian couple, or a same-sex couple of any other pairing, run into a specific set of coverage and tax mistakes that single filers rarely encounter:
intro.es: Las parejas LGBTQ, ya sea una pareja gay, una pareja lesbiana o una pareja del mismo sexo de cualquier otra combinacion, enfrentan un conjunto especifico de errores de cobertura e impuestos que los declarantes solteros rara vez encuentran:

en: Filing separately as a married same-sex couple to try to shrink reported income

Married couples, including same-sex married couples, must file jointly to receive the Premium Tax Credit. Filing Married Filing Separately disqualifies the household from PTC entirely, one of the most expensive Marketplace mistakes a couple can make.
es: Declarar por separado como pareja del mismo sexo casada para reducir el ingreso reportado

Las parejas casadas, incluyendo las parejas del mismo sexo casadas, deben declarar conjuntamente para recibir el Credito Fiscal de Prima. Declarar como Casado Presentando por Separado descalifica al hogar del PTC por completo.

en: Adding a domestic partner to an employer plan without checking dependent status first

Employer-paid premiums for a domestic partner who is not a tax dependent under IRC Section 152 become imputed income taxed as wages. Running the math before enrollment sometimes shows a separate Marketplace plan costs less than the imputed income hit.
es: Agregar a una pareja domestica al plan del empleador sin revisar primero el estado de dependiente
Las primas pagadas por el empleador para una pareja domestica que no es dependiente fiscal se convierten en ingreso imputado sujeto a impuestos.

en: Assuming domestic partnership registration works the same in every state

Several states stopped accepting new domestic partnership registrations for opposite-sex couples after marriage equality, and some employers dropped domestic partner benefits entirely once staff could marry. Confirm your state's and your employer's current rules before relying on registered domestic partner status.
es: Suponer que el registro de pareja domestica funciona igual en todos los estados

Varios estados dejaron de aceptar nuevos registros de pareja domestica para parejas de sexo opuesto tras la igualdad matrimonial, y algunos empleadores eliminaron los beneficios de pareja domestica por completo.

en: Health share ministries marketed as a cheaper couple's plan

Health share ministries are NOT insurance and carry no legal obligation to pay claims. Many contain lifestyle clauses that specifically exclude coverage tied to a same-sex spouse or domestic partner. Avoid using one as a couple's primary coverage.
es: Ministerios de compartir salud comercializados como un plan de pareja mas barato

Los ministerios de compartir salud NO son seguro y no tienen obligacion legal de pagar reclamaciones. Muchos contienen clausulas de estilo de vida que excluyen especificamente la cobertura ligada a un conyuge del mismo sexo o pareja domestica.

footnote.en: Verify any plan on healthcare.gov or your state exchange before enrolling a spouse or domestic partner, and confirm imputed income treatment with your employer's HR or benefits team in writing.
footnote.es: Verifique cualquier plan en healthcare.gov o su intercambio estatal antes de inscribir a un conyuge o pareja domestica, y confirme el tratamiento del ingreso imputado por escrito con recursos humanos.

heading.en: Premium Tax Credit (PTC) eligibility for LGBTQ couples in 2026
heading.es: Elegibilidad del Credito Fiscal de Prima (PTC) para parejas LGBTQ en 2026

paragraphs.en: A same-sex married couple's Premium Tax Credit eligibility in 2026 hinges on one number: 400% of the Federal Poverty Level, measured against combined household MAGI. For a household of two that is $86,560; for a household of four (a same-sex married couple raising two children) it is $132,000. Subsidies phase down as income climbs toward that line and stop at 400% FPL exactly, a cliff that returned January 1, 2026 when the Enhanced Premium Tax Credits from the Inflation Reduction Act of 2022 expired.
paragraphs.es: La elegibilidad del Credito Fiscal de Prima de una pareja del mismo sexo casada en 2026 depende de un numero: el 400% del Nivel Federal de Pobreza, medido contra el MAGI combinado del hogar. Para un hogar de dos son $86,560; para un hogar de cuatro son $132,000. Los subsidios disminuyen a medida que el ingreso se acerca a esa linea y se detienen exactamente en el 400% FPL.

paragraphs.en: An unmarried domestic partner calculates PTC as an individual household using only their own MAGI against the same-size table for one person, which is why two domestic partners each earning a moderate income can sometimes out-earn a married couple in combined subsidies. Whichever path applies, Section 1095-A arrives each February and reconciles advance credits against actual income on Form 8962 when the household files.
paragraphs.es: Una pareja domestica no casada calcula el PTC como hogar individual usando solo su propio MAGI contra la tabla del mismo tamano para una persona, por lo que dos parejas domesticas que ganan un ingreso moderado a veces pueden superar en subsidios combinados a una pareja casada. La Seccion 1095-A llega cada febrero y reconcilia los creditos anticipados contra el ingreso real en el Formulario 8962.

list.en: 100% to 138% FPL: Medicaid territory in the 40 expansion states plus DC. Below 100% FPL in a non-expansion state, neither PTC nor Medicaid applies (the coverage gap).
list.es: 100% a 138% FPL: territorio de Medicaid en los 40 estados de expansion mas DC. Por debajo del 100% FPL en un estado sin expansion, no aplica ni el PTC ni Medicaid.

list.en: 138% to 250% FPL: Eligible for cost-sharing reductions (CSRs) on Silver plans in addition to PTC, lowering deductibles and out-of-pocket maximums.
list.es: 138% a 250% FPL: elegible para reducciones de costos compartidos (CSR) en planes Silver ademas del PTC.

list.en: 250% to 400% FPL: PTC phases down steadily; premium costs climb fastest in the 350% to 400% band.
list.es: 250% a 400% FPL: el PTC disminuye de forma constante; los costos de prima suben mas rapido entre el 350% y el 400%.

list.en: Above 400% FPL: No PTC, full sticker price. An HSA-qualified family HDHP is usually the strongest option at this income level.
list.es: Por encima del 400% FPL: sin PTC, precio completo. Un HDHP familiar compatible con HSA suele ser la mejor opcion en este nivel de ingreso.

caption.en: 2026 Federal Poverty Level thresholds by household size for LGBTQ couples
caption.es: Umbrales del Nivel Federal de Pobreza 2026 por tamano de hogar para parejas LGBTQ

footnote.en: A same-sex married couple uses the household-of-two row (or larger, with dependents) with combined MAGI. An unmarried domestic partner without a shared dependent uses the household-of-one row with only their own MAGI.
footnote.es: Una pareja del mismo sexo casada usa la fila de hogar de dos (o mayor, con dependientes) con el MAGI combinado. Una pareja domestica no casada sin un dependiente compartido usa la fila de hogar de uno con solo su propio MAGI.

heading.en: HSA and HDHP fit for LGBTQ couples in 2026
heading.es: Ajuste del HSA y HDHP para parejas LGBTQ en 2026

paragraphs.en: A Health Savings Account (HSA) is only available to someone enrolled in an HSA-qualified HDHP, and it works differently from a Flexible Spending Account (FSA), which is employer-sponsored only. Most LGBTQ couples without employer coverage have no FSA access at all, which makes the HSA the primary tax-advantaged tool for a same-sex couple's out-of-pocket medical spending, including fertility treatment, adoption-related medical costs, and routine care.
paragraphs.es: Una Cuenta de Ahorros para la Salud (HSA) solo esta disponible para alguien inscrito en un HDHP compatible con HSA, y funciona diferente de una Cuenta de Gastos Flexibles (FSA), que es solo del empleador. La mayoria de las parejas LGBTQ sin cobertura del empleador no tienen acceso a un FSA, lo que hace del HSA la herramienta principal con ventajas fiscales para el gasto medico de bolsillo de una pareja del mismo sexo.

paragraphs.en: The married-versus-unmarried HSA contribution rule is worth repeating because it changes household strategy directly: a same-sex married couple shares one $8,750 family limit for 2026 (plus a $1,000 catch-up each if 55 or older), while two domestic partners covered under the same family HDHP, neither claimed as the other's tax dependent, can each contribute up to $8,750 to their own separate HSA. HSA contributions are also deductible above the line, which lowers MAGI and can help a couple near the 400% FPL cliff land just under it.
paragraphs.es: La regla de aporte al HSA para casados versus no casados vale la pena repetirla porque cambia directamente la estrategia del hogar: una pareja del mismo sexo casada comparte un limite familiar de $8,750 para 2026, mientras que dos parejas domesticas cubiertas bajo el mismo HDHP familiar, sin ser dependientes fiscales entre si, pueden aportar cada una hasta $8,750 a su propia HSA separada. Los aportes al HSA tambien son deducibles above-the-line, lo que reduce el MAGI.

caption.en: 2026 HSA and HDHP limits (IRS Rev. Proc. 2025-19)
caption.es: Limites de HSA y HDHP para 2026 (IRS Rev. Proc. 2025-19)

footnote.en: The 2026 ACA Marketplace out-of-pocket maximum ($10,600 individual / $21,200 family) is separate and slightly higher than the HDHP cap above; not every marketplace HDHP is HSA-qualified, so check the plan label before assuming HSA eligibility.
footnote.es: El maximo de bolsillo del Mercado ACA 2026 ($10,600 individual / $21,200 familiar) es un tope separado y ligeramente mas alto que el del HDHP anterior; no todos los HDHP del mercado son compatibles con HSA.

heading.en: Domestic partnership registration and civil unions still recognized in 2026
heading.es: Registro de pareja domestica y uniones civiles reconocidas en 2026

paragraphs.en: Registered domestic partnership is still a live legal status in 2026, even though same-sex marriage has been available nationwide since the Obergefell v. Hodges ruling in 2015. California maintains a statewide Domestic Partners Registry through the Secretary of State open to any two adults regardless of sex or age, since Senate Bill 30 removed the prior same-sex-any-age and opposite-sex-62-plus restrictions effective January 1, 2020. Washington, Nevada, Colorado, Hawaii, Maine, New Jersey, Oregon, and Wisconsin each maintain their own domestic partnership or civil union frameworks with varying benefits, and Illinois and New Jersey both still recognize civil unions entered into before those states adopted marriage equality.
paragraphs.es: La pareja domestica registrada sigue siendo un estatus legal vigente en 2026, aunque el matrimonio del mismo sexo esta disponible a nivel nacional desde el fallo Obergefell v. Hodges en 2015. California mantiene un Registro de Parejas Domesticas estatal a traves de la Secretaria de Estado abierto a cualquier pareja de adultos sin importar el sexo o la edad, desde que la Ley del Senado 30 elimino las restricciones anteriores a partir del 1 de enero de 2020. Washington, Nevada, Colorado, Hawaii, Maine, Nueva Jersey, Oregon y Wisconsin mantienen sus propios marcos de pareja domestica o union civil.

paragraphs.en: A registered domestic partner or civil union partner does not automatically get the same federal tax treatment as a legal spouse. The federal government only recognizes marriage for Premium Tax Credit joint filing and for excluding employer-paid premiums from taxable income. State-level domestic partnership and civil union status can still unlock employer plan eligibility, state tax exclusions in some states like California, and hospital visitation and medical decision-making rights, so a gay couple or lesbian couple weighing marriage against a domestic partnership should confirm both federal and state consequences before choosing.
paragraphs.es: Una pareja domestica registrada o de union civil no obtiene automaticamente el mismo trato fiscal federal que un conyuge legal. El gobierno federal solo reconoce el matrimonio para la declaracion conjunta del Credito Fiscal de Prima y para excluir las primas pagadas por el empleador del ingreso sujeto a impuestos. El estatus de pareja domestica o union civil a nivel estatal puede seguir habilitando elegibilidad en el plan del empleador y derechos de visita hospitalaria.

list.en: California: statewide Domestic Partners Registry via the Secretary of State, open to any two adults regardless of sex or age since Senate Bill 30 (2020).
list.es: California: Registro de Parejas Domesticas estatal via la Secretaria de Estado, abierto a cualquier pareja de adultos sin importar el sexo o la edad desde la Ley del Senado 30 (2020).

list.en: Washington and Nevada: domestic partnership registries with state-level rights similar to marriage.
list.es: Washington y Nevada: registros de pareja domestica con derechos a nivel estatal similares al matrimonio.

list.en: Colorado and Hawaii: civil union or reciprocal beneficiary options alongside marriage.
list.es: Colorado y Hawaii: opciones de union civil o beneficiario reciproco junto al matrimonio.

list.en: Illinois and New Jersey: pre-existing civil unions remain legally valid even though new civil unions are rarely registered post-marriage-equality.
list.es: Illinois y Nueva Jersey: las uniones civiles preexistentes siguen siendo legalmente validas aunque rara vez se registran nuevas uniones civiles.

list.en: Maine, Oregon, and Wisconsin: limited domestic partnership frameworks, mostly for benefits access rather than full marital rights.
list.es: Maine, Oregon y Wisconsin: marcos limitados de pareja domestica, principalmente para acceso a beneficios.

heading.en: Marketplace Special Enrollment Period (SEP) triggers for LGBTQ couples and how to enroll a partner
heading.es: Disparadores del Periodo de Inscripcion Especial (SEP) del Mercado para parejas LGBTQ y como inscribir a un socio

paragraphs.en: A Marketplace Special Enrollment Period gives an LGBTQ couple a 60-day window around a qualifying life event to enroll in or change coverage outside Open Enrollment (November 1 through January 15 in most states for 2026 plans). Marriage to a same-sex spouse is the single most common trigger: the couple has 60 days from the wedding date to enroll jointly or add the new spouse to an existing plan. Divorce, the death of a same-sex spouse, and losing a domestic partner's employer coverage after a breakup each open their own 60-day SEP, as does moving to a new state or having or adopting a child.
paragraphs.es: Un Periodo de Inscripcion Especial del Mercado le da a una pareja LGBTQ una ventana de 60 dias alrededor de un evento calificador para inscribirse o cambiar de cobertura fuera de la Inscripcion Abierta. Casarse con un conyuge del mismo sexo es el disparador mas comun: la pareja tiene 60 dias desde la fecha de la boda para inscribirse conjuntamente o agregar al nuevo conyuge a un plan existente. El divorcio, la muerte de un conyuge del mismo sexo y perder la cobertura del empleador de una pareja domestica tras una ruptura tambien abren su propio SEP de 60 dias.

paragraphs.en: To enroll a spouse or domestic partner: first, gather the marriage certificate or domestic partnership declaration, Social Security numbers, and recent income documents for both partners. Second, decide whether the household files jointly (married) or as separate applications (unmarried), since that choice determines which FPL row applies. Third, submit the application at healthcare.gov or your state exchange within the 60-day window; applications submitted after the window closes are the most common reason a partner's enrollment gets denied outside a documented qualifying event. Fourth, confirm the effective date and, for a newly married spouse, verify the employer plan's own enrollment deadline if that route is chosen instead.
paragraphs.es: Para inscribir a un conyuge o pareja domestica: primero, reuna el acta de matrimonio o la declaracion de pareja domestica, los numeros de Seguro Social y los documentos de ingresos recientes de ambos. Segundo, decida si el hogar declara conjuntamente (casados) o como solicitudes separadas (no casados). Tercero, envie la solicitud en healthcare.gov o su intercambio estatal dentro de la ventana de 60 dias; las solicitudes enviadas despues de que cierra la ventana son la razon mas comun por la que se niega la inscripcion de un socio. Cuarto, confirme la fecha de vigencia.

list.en: Marriage to a same-sex spouse: 60-day SEP from the wedding date (45 CFR 155.420).
list.es: Matrimonio con un conyuge del mismo sexo: SEP de 60 dias desde la fecha de la boda.

list.en: Divorce or legal separation from a same-sex spouse: 60-day SEP from the final decree.
list.es: Divorcio o separacion legal de un conyuge del mismo sexo: SEP de 60 dias desde el decreto final.

list.en: Death of a same-sex spouse: 60-day SEP from the date of death for the surviving spouse.
list.es: Muerte de un conyuge del mismo sexo: SEP de 60 dias desde la fecha del fallecimiento.

list.en: Loss of a domestic partner's employer coverage after a breakup or job change: 60-day SEP from the coverage end date.
list.es: Perdida de la cobertura del empleador de una pareja domestica tras una ruptura: SEP de 60 dias desde la fecha de fin de cobertura.

list.en: Having or adopting a child, including second-parent adoption: 60-day SEP from the birth or finalized adoption date.
list.es: Tener o adoptar un hijo, incluyendo adopcion del segundo padre: SEP de 60 dias desde el nacimiento o adopcion finalizada.

list.en: Moving to a new state: 60-day SEP from the move date.
list.es: Mudarse a un nuevo estado: SEP de 60 dias desde la fecha de mudanza.

list.en: Income change crossing the Medicaid threshold: 60-day SEP from the month income changes.
list.es: Cambio de ingresos que cruza el umbral de Medicaid: SEP de 60 dias desde el mes en que cambia el ingreso.

heading.en: Filing status, imputed income, catastrophic plans, and children in LGBTQ couple households
heading.es: Estado civil fiscal, ingreso imputado, planes catastroficos e hijos en hogares de parejas LGBTQ

paragraphs.en: Filing status is the single biggest fork in the road for a same-sex couple's coverage math. Married Filing Jointly is required for PTC eligibility and combines both spouses' MAGI, income, and household size into one calculation. Two unmarried domestic partners each file as Single or Head of Household (if a dependent qualifies) and are evaluated independently for Marketplace subsidies, Medicaid, and CSR eligibility, with no legal mechanism to combine their income even if they want to.
paragraphs.es: El estado civil fiscal es la bifurcacion mas importante en las matematicas de cobertura de una pareja del mismo sexo. Casado Presentando Conjuntamente es obligatorio para la elegibilidad del PTC y combina el MAGI, ingreso y tamano del hogar de ambos conyuges en un solo calculo. Dos parejas domesticas no casadas declaran cada una como Soltero o Cabeza de Familia y se evaluan de forma independiente para subsidios del Mercado, Medicaid y elegibilidad de CSR.

paragraphs.en: Catastrophic plans are not generally available to most LGBTQ couples. Marketplace catastrophic plans are restricted to enrollees under 30 or those holding a hardship exemption, and eligibility is determined per individual, not per couple; a 28-year-old partner could enroll in a catastrophic plan on their own while a 35-year-old spouse could not. Form 7206, the self-employed health insurance deduction, does not apply to most LGBTQ couples because it requires net self-employment income; a couple where both partners are W-2 employees, both on a same-sex spouse's employer plan, or a domestic partner claimed as a dependent has no access to it. When one partner does file Schedule C as a freelancer or contractor, Form 7206 lets that partner deduct 100% of premiums above the line, but the deduction reduces federal income tax only; it does NOT reduce self-employment tax on Schedule SE.
paragraphs.es: Los planes catastroficos generalmente no estan disponibles para la mayoria de las parejas LGBTQ. Los planes catastroficos del Mercado estan restringidos a inscritos menores de 30 anos o quienes tienen una exencion por dificultades, y la elegibilidad se determina por individuo, no por pareja. El Formulario 7206, la deduccion de seguro medico para autoempleados, no aplica a la mayoria de las parejas LGBTQ porque requiere ingreso neto del trabajo independiente. Cuando un socio si presenta Schedule C como freelancer o contratista, el Formulario 7206 le permite deducir el 100% de las primas above-the-line, pero la deduccion reduce SOLO el impuesto sobre la renta federal; NO reduce el impuesto al trabajo independiente en el Schedule SE.

paragraphs.en: A child raised by a same-sex couple, whether through second-parent adoption, surrogacy, or a prior relationship, can be added to either parent's plan during open enrollment or within a 60-day SEP from the birth or finalized adoption. ACA Section 2714 lets that child stay on a parent's plan until age 26 regardless of the parent's marital status or the child's own relationship status. Second-parent adoption paperwork strengthens a non-biological parent's ability to add the child as a dependent for tax and coverage purposes, so finalizing the adoption before a plan year starts avoids gaps in dependent eligibility.
paragraphs.es: Un hijo criado por una pareja del mismo sexo, ya sea mediante adopcion del segundo padre, subrogacion o una relacion anterior, puede agregarse al plan de cualquiera de los padres durante la inscripcion abierta o dentro de un SEP de 60 dias desde el nacimiento o la adopcion finalizada. La Seccion 2714 del ACA permite que ese hijo permanezca en el plan de un padre hasta los 26 anos sin importar el estado civil del padre.

en.question: What is the cheapest health insurance option for LGBTQ couples in 2026?
en.answer: For a same-sex married couple with combined MAGI under 400% FPL ($86,560 for a household of two in 2026), a Silver Marketplace plan with the Premium Tax Credit is usually cheapest, with added cost-sharing reductions below 250% FPL. For a couple above the subsidy cliff, an HSA-qualified family HDHP paired with a maxed HSA typically produces the lowest after-tax total cost. A gay couple or a lesbian couple who is unmarried should each price out their own individual Marketplace subsidy separately as domestic partners, since it sometimes beats a married household's combined subsidy.

en.question: Do LGBTQ couples need to file jointly to get the Premium Tax Credit?
en.answer: Only if they are legally married. A same-sex married couple must file Married Filing Jointly to receive the Premium Tax Credit; filing separately disqualifies the household from PTC entirely. Unmarried domestic partners, including registered domestic partners, generally do not file jointly at all under federal tax law and instead apply for Marketplace coverage as two separate households, each using their own MAGI against the individual FPL thresholds.

en.question: Can an unmarried domestic partner join my employer health plan?
en.answer: Many employers still offer domestic partner benefits even though same-sex marriage is legal nationwide, but check your specific employer's policy first. If your domestic partner does not qualify as your tax dependent under IRC Section 152, the fair market value of their employer-paid coverage becomes imputed income added to your W-2 as taxable wages, typically $1,000 to $1,700 in extra federal tax per year at typical premium levels. Compare that cost against a subsidized individual Marketplace plan for your partner before deciding.

en.question: Can LGBTQ couples deduct health insurance premiums on taxes?
en.answer: Generally no, because Form 7206 requires net self-employment income and most couples are W-2 employees. If one partner in the couple files Schedule C as a freelancer, consultant, or contractor, that partner can use Form 7206 to deduct 100% of premiums above the line on Schedule 1, lowering federal income tax and MAGI. The deduction reduces income tax only; it does NOT reduce the 15.3% self-employment tax calculated on Schedule SE.

en.question: Can LGBTQ couples use an HSA together?
en.answer: Marital status determines the answer. A same-sex married couple with family HDHP coverage shares one combined $8,750 HSA contribution limit for 2026, split between two separate HSA accounts however they choose, plus a $1,000 catch-up each if 55 or older. Two unmarried domestic partners covered under the same family HDHP, if neither is the other's tax dependent, can each open a separate HSA and contribute up to the full $8,750 family limit individually, which can roughly double the household's tax-advantaged HSA savings compared to a married couple.

en.question: What if our combined income is too high for subsidies?
en.answer: A same-sex married couple with combined MAGI above 400% FPL ($86,560 for a household of two in 2026) gets no Premium Tax Credit and pays full sticker price on the Marketplace. An HSA-qualified family HDHP at full price, paired with a maxed HSA contribution, usually produces the lowest after-tax cost at that income level. Timing HSA contributions, retirement contributions, and (for a self-employed partner) the Form 7206 deduction can sometimes bring combined MAGI back under the cliff if the couple is close to the line.

en.question: When can LGBTQ couples enroll in a Marketplace plan outside open enrollment?
en.answer: A Marketplace Special Enrollment Period opens for 60 days after a qualifying life event. For LGBTQ couples, common triggers include marriage to a same-sex spouse, divorce or the death of a spouse, losing a domestic partner's employer coverage after a breakup or job change, moving to a new state, having or adopting a child, and income changes crossing the Medicaid eligibility threshold. Open enrollment for 2027 coverage begins November 1, 2026 in most states.

en.question: Does my state still recognize domestic partnerships or civil unions in 2026?
en.answer: Several states do. California maintains a statewide Domestic Partners Registry through the Secretary of State open to any two adults regardless of sex or age since Senate Bill 30 took effect in 2020. Washington, Nevada, Colorado, Hawaii, Maine, New Jersey, Oregon, and Wisconsin each maintain their own domestic partnership or civil union framework, though benefits vary widely and some states have limited new registrations since marriage equality. Registered domestic partner and civil union status generally does not get the same federal tax treatment as marriage, so confirm both state and federal consequences before choosing between marriage and domestic partnership.

es.question: ¿Cual es la opcion de seguro medico mas barata para parejas LGBTQ en 2026?
es.answer: Para una pareja del mismo sexo casada con MAGI combinado bajo el 400% FPL ($86,560 para un hogar de dos en 2026), un plan Silver del Mercado con el Credito Fiscal de Prima suele ser el mas barato, con reducciones de costos compartidos adicionales bajo el 250% FPL. Para una pareja por encima del tope del subsidio, un HDHP familiar compatible con HSA junto con un HSA maximizado suele producir el costo total mas bajo despues de impuestos. Las parejas domesticas deben cotizar cada una su propio subsidio individual del Mercado por separado.

es.question: ¿Las parejas LGBTQ necesitan declarar conjuntamente para obtener el Credito Fiscal de Prima?
es.answer: Solo si estan legalmente casadas. Una pareja del mismo sexo casada debe declarar como Casado Presentando Conjuntamente para recibir el Credito Fiscal de Prima; declarar por separado descalifica al hogar del PTC por completo. Las parejas domesticas no casadas, incluyendo las parejas domesticas registradas, generalmente no declaran conjuntamente bajo la ley fiscal federal y en su lugar solicitan cobertura del Mercado como dos hogares separados.

es.question: ¿Puede una pareja domestica no casada unirse a mi plan de salud del empleador?
es.answer: Muchos empleadores todavia ofrecen beneficios de pareja domestica aunque el matrimonio del mismo sexo es legal a nivel nacional, pero verifique la politica de su empleador especifico primero. Si su pareja domestica no califica como su dependiente fiscal bajo la Seccion 152 del IRC, el valor de mercado de su cobertura pagada por el empleador se convierte en ingreso imputado agregado a su W-2 como salario sujeto a impuestos, tipicamente $1,000 a $1,700 mas en impuesto federal al ano.

es.question: ¿Las parejas LGBTQ pueden deducir las primas de seguro medico en sus impuestos?
es.answer: Generalmente no, porque el Formulario 7206 requiere ingreso neto del trabajo independiente y la mayoria de las parejas son empleados W-2. Si un socio de la pareja presenta Schedule C como freelancer, consultor o contratista, ese socio puede usar el Formulario 7206 para deducir el 100% de las primas above-the-line en el Schedule 1, reduciendo el impuesto federal sobre la renta y el MAGI. La deduccion reduce SOLO el impuesto sobre la renta; NO reduce el 15.3% del impuesto al trabajo independiente calculado en el Schedule SE.

es.question: ¿Las parejas LGBTQ pueden usar un HSA juntas?
es.answer: Depende del estado civil. Una pareja del mismo sexo casada con cobertura HDHP familiar comparte un limite combinado de aporte al HSA de $8,750 para 2026, dividido entre dos cuentas HSA separadas como decidan, mas un aporte adicional de $1,000 cada uno si tienen 55 anos o mas. Dos parejas domesticas no casadas cubiertas bajo el mismo HDHP familiar, si ninguna es dependiente fiscal de la otra, pueden abrir cada una una HSA separada y aportar hasta el limite familiar completo de $8,750 individualmente.

es.question: ¿Que pasa si nuestro ingreso combinado es demasiado alto para subsidios?
es.answer: Una pareja del mismo sexo casada con MAGI combinado por encima del 400% FPL ($86,560 para un hogar de dos en 2026) no recibe Credito Fiscal de Prima y paga el precio completo en el Mercado. Un HDHP familiar compatible con HSA a precio completo, junto con un aporte maximo al HSA, suele producir el costo mas bajo despues de impuestos en ese nivel de ingreso. Programar los aportes al HSA, al retiro y, para un socio autoempleado, la deduccion del Formulario 7206, a veces puede bajar el MAGI combinado por debajo del tope.

es.question: ¿Cuando pueden las parejas LGBTQ inscribirse en un plan del Mercado fuera de la inscripcion abierta?
es.answer: Un Periodo de Inscripcion Especial del Mercado se abre por 60 dias despues de un evento calificador de vida. Para las parejas LGBTQ, los disparadores comunes incluyen matrimonio con un conyuge del mismo sexo, divorcio o muerte de un conyuge, perdida de la cobertura del empleador de una pareja domestica tras una ruptura o cambio de trabajo, mudanza a un nuevo estado, tener o adoptar un hijo, y cambios de ingreso que cruzan el umbral de elegibilidad de Medicaid. La inscripcion abierta para la cobertura de 2027 comienza el 1 de noviembre de 2026 en la mayoria de los estados.

es.question: ¿Mi estado todavia reconoce las parejas domesticas o uniones civiles en 2026?
es.answer: Varios estados si. California mantiene un Registro de Parejas Domesticas estatal a traves de la Secretaria de Estado, abierto a cualquier pareja de adultos sin importar el sexo o la edad desde que la Ley del Senado 30 entro en vigor en 2020. Washington, Nevada, Colorado, Hawaii, Maine, Nueva Jersey, Oregon y Wisconsin mantienen cada uno su propio marco de pareja domestica o union civil, aunque los beneficios varian ampliamente. El estatus de pareja domestica registrada o union civil generalmente no recibe el mismo trato fiscal federal que el matrimonio, asi que confirme las consecuencias estatales y federales antes de elegir.
